classificationRules.titleSlideRole: reserved slide-name marker mdst-title-<document-uuid>; placeholder type is not used to determine the slide's role
classificationRules.caption: local TEXT_BOX only when name starts mdst-caption-; unmarked text boxes are unsupported

inheritedVsLocal.rule: Enumerate slide-local shapes only via slide.shapes. Master/layout prototypes are separately inventoried and are not included in the slide-local classification input.

limitations: T-301 probe verifies python-pptx/Open XML package behavior, not Microsoft PowerPoint desktop save behavior.
Current baseline caption is unmarked and classifies as unsupported-unmarked-textbox; the M3-capable render must stamp the reserved marker before import is implemented.
Bullet style is inherited from the body placeholder/layout; paragraph 0 uses explicit a:buNone, ordered list uses a:buAutoNum.
